notes.title: Maintenance Update
notes.content: Today's update is a maintenance one. It fixes some rare issues with shaders and certain achievements.

tags.bug: - It fixes some rare issues with shaders and certain achievements.

notes.title: Unexpected Update!
notes.content:
Sky Force 2014 was a very colorful shmup. When porting it for TVs we've toned down the colors a little bit, since most modern TVs tend to oversaturate the picture. It looked quite well. But as the time went by, these juicy colors of the original were missed by some.

Today's update brings you the ability to choose between the original, warm color scheme and Anniversary's default, cooler colors.
There's also a small addition in the form of autofire for gamepads. Both settings are available in the Options menu. 

Please enjoy, unless you're really busy playing [b]Sky Force Reloaded[/b].
